map.输入图像分辨率（像素）、位深与文件格式（RAW/JPEG），工具估算单张照片的存: Enter the image resolution (pixels), bit depth and file format (RAW/JPEG); the tool estimates the storage a single photo takes and shows that JPEG is much smaller than RAW because of compression, helping plan card capacity and backup.
map.未压缩大小 = 像素数 × 位深 / 8压缩后 ≈ 未压缩 / 压缩比: Uncompressed size = pixel count x bit depth / 8; compressed size = uncompressed / compression ratio
map.由像素与位深算单张未压缩大小。: Compute the uncompressed size of one image from pixels and bit depth.
map.按压缩比估实际文件。: Estimate the actual file from the compression ratio.
map.：24MP、14bit：未压缩 = 24e6×14/8/1e6 ≈ 42MB；压: 24MP, 14bit: uncompressed = 24e6 x 14/8/1e6 = about 42MB; compression ratio 4 -> about 10.5MB per image, and 100 frames in a burst is about 1GB.
map.：同 24MP 改 12bit：未压缩 = 24×12/8 = 36MB，降 6: Same 24MP at 12bit: uncompressed = 24 x 12/8 = 36MB, 6MB less; higher bit depth keeps more grading room but occupies more card space.
map.未压缩大小怎么算？: How is the uncompressed size calculated?
map.像素数×位深(bit)÷8 = 字节，再转 MB；RAW 多含元数据与冗余略大于: Pixel count x bit depth (bit) / 8 = bytes, then convert to MB; RAW is slightly larger because of metadata and redundancy.
map.无损压缩约 1.2–1.5×，有损 JPEG 可达 5–10×；估存储用典型比并: Lossless compression is about 1.2-1.5x, while lossy JPEG can reach 5-10x; use typical ratios for storage estimates and leave margin.
